GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, no early pace & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 10 Lengths rail turning, dropped right out in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed bilateral epistaxis (first time). provisions of AR79(4) invoked.] # Bled. 3-month ban.
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
Jumped Ok , enjoyed rails trail behind speed 2 Lengths 700m, stayed hard on fence and gap opened to give her chance at 200m, she battled on well and grabbed minor placing # rail hugging place
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the home turn, momentarily steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked over to settle outside leader. 2nd turn going out wide. battled away # worked early
Jumped ok Wide out settled down 6 Lengths off the lead a little Wide (700m), Further back for home work to do, didn't get a lot of room to 200 however no run on # bit against/forgive

Jumped okay & Went Forward to 3 Wide Lead settling down, crossed 700m, Held Together in front 7 led 1 length rail turning, steered centre of track Straightening Up and got progressively wider in the run, Headed 25m from post. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) OFF FIRST TIME) # led/battled on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out under pressure over the final 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then worked forward and led Two Wide jointly settling down, Headed at the 1100m, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, eased down from the 200m. [Stewards: Eased down from 200m. Rider reported it raced flat and may have come to the end of its preparation. Post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery and mild lameness in the off foreleg. Vet clearance required.] # P/up mildly lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in near the 900m. Eased down from the 200m. Rdr reported filly raced flat and may have come to the end of its preparation. A post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery and mild lameness in off foreleg. Vet cert prior to racing or trialling again. Passed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , held together much same to turn 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , hit Lead 250m and kept going to post # solid win

Jumped okay & 3 Lengths 3 Wide , little change to 3.5 Lengths Four Wide turning, Hooked Out wider Straightening Up and Made Ground in straight. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME) # wide, kept coming
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, shifted out Straightening Up and kept trying to the line # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began on fairly and was bumped shortly after on two occasions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a half length, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , kept gradually getting closer down the running, got up in the final stride # got up on post
